definitions.ask: Should the raw-commit backstop ignore SASE tool commits that carry no agent trailer?

choices.label: Human SASE tool commits in shared siblings stop failing running agents
Every human home-memory refresh during agent runs keeps failing running agents

definitions.why: raw git commit never writes SASE_TYPE, and change 3 makes in-agent tool commits name their agent

definitions.ask: Should --check report home-memory drift as a deferred warning for humans too, not only in agents?

choices.label: Home drift warns everywhere like init skills --check; stale home deploys stop failing validate
Only agent and monitor runs demote home drift; humans keep the hard check failure

definitions.why: matches the existing init skills --check precedent for home-deploy drift
